descriptions.text: Carl's Doomsday Scenario. Type: Unstable custom explosive. Effect: An explosion large enough to rattle the teeth of a god. Status: Explosion Imminent. Created by a man who murders babies and steals rare collectibles from his elders, this device is powerful enough to level an entire city and all the suburbs around it. It is created by combining a massively overloaded soul crystal and a Sheol Glass Reaper Case. Warning: This item can no longer be stabilized.

recap.text: During the Fools Who Broke the Glass, Carl drops a Sheol Glass Reaper Case around a Soul Crystal and pulls the result into his inventory. The item is an unstable custom explosive that cannot be stabilized and will detonate less than a second after leaving his inventory. It can destroy a city and every suburb around it.

Carl sets the Doomsday Scenario on a workbench in the Advanced Bomber's Studio. The bench reshapes itself around the glass reaper case, which glows like a miniature sun. Carl copies the explosive into a simulator before it explodes and puts it back in his inventory with trembling hands.

beats.headline: Built in the middle of a collapse
beats.text: During the Fools Who Broke the Glass, Carl drops a Sheol Glass Reaper Case around a Soul Crystal that is already going up and pulls the result into his inventory. Status: Explosion Imminent. "This item can no longer be stabilized."
beats.gist: Carl drops a Sheol Glass Reaper Case around a rising Soul Crystal and inventories the result.

beats.headline: Forty-five square kilometres
beats.text: Enough to take a city and every suburb around it. It can no longer be stabilized, and the moment it leaves his inventory it goes off, with less than a second to spare. "Created by a man who murders babies and steals rare collectibles from his elders."
beats.gist: An unstable custom explosive can destroy a city and its suburbs once it leaves Carl's inventory.

beats.headline: On the bench
beats.text: The Advanced Bomber's Studio has a workbench built for examining and dissecting explosives, and Carl sets the Doomsday Scenario on it: the first time he has taken it out of his inventory since he grabbed it. The bench reshapes itself around the glass reaper case, which glows like a miniature sun. It is a microsecond from exploding and there is nothing he can do to stop that. He can copy it into the studio's simulator, where it can be played with safely, and he does. Then it goes back into his inventory, his hands still trembling.
beats.gist: Carl sets the Doomsday Scenario on a workbench in the Advanced Bomber's Studio and copies it.

relations.note: The convulsion that ends him is where the scenario begins.
